Container.Name: mixarr

Branch.TagDescription: Moving stable release (v3.0.0 is also available as a pinned tag)

Container.Overview:
Mixarr v3.0.0 is a self-hosted music discovery and catalog companion for Lidarr.
This is an all-in-one container that includes everything needed to run - no external database or Redis required!
Features: - Compact music catalog with a shared artist inspector and discovery sources - Collaboration Constellation: explore credited musicians, producers, songwriters, and engineers - Review queue with clear acquisition outcomes and eligible decision Undo - Music sources include Spotify, TIDAL, Deezer, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, MusicBrainz, Plex, Jellyfin, Discogs, and Bandcamp - Automated Subscriptions: Scheduled sync from connected services - AI-Powered Discovery: Get recommendations based on your library - Installable PWA; provider discovery requires network access - Built-in MariaDB and Redis - no external dependencies needed
Unified and slim images are available for AMD64 and ARM64. This template uses the unified image. Before upgrading, back up /data and retain its mapping and SESSION_SECRET. Released v2 schemas migrate directly; do not reset the database. Read the v3.0.0 release notes for custom API changes and known provider limitations.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lidarr music spotify tidal deezer lastfm plex discovery recommendation

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data storage (database, Redis data, SSL certificates). All application data is stored here.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Persistent secret for session signing. Generate once with: openssl rand -hex 32. Retain the existing value during upgrades.

Config.Name: Frontend URL
Config.Description: Public URL where Mixarr is accessible. Used for OAuth callbacks (Spotify, etc). Example: https://192.168.1.100:3443

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Same as Frontend URL. Leave empty to auto-use FRONTEND_URL value.
